**City:** Hyderabad

**Wipro Limited (NYSE:** WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.
  
  

Role Purpose
  
  

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters
  
  

͏
  
  

Do
  
  

1\. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software
  
  

Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
  
Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
  
Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
  
Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
  
Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
  
Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
  
Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities
  
͏
  
  

2\. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development
  
  

Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
  
Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
  
Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
  
Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
  
Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
  
Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
  
Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
  
Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
  
Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
  
Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders
  
͏
  
  

3\. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution
  
  

Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
  
Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
  
Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
  
Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software\-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
  
Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
  
Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
  
Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e\-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
  
Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally
  
͏
  
  

Deliver
  
  

No. Performance Parameter Measure
  
1\. Continuous Integration, Deployment \& Monitoring of Software 100% error free on boarding \& implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan
  
2\. Quality \& CSAT On\-Time Delivery, Manage software, Troubleshoot queries, Customer experience, completion of assigned certifications for skill upgradation
  
3\. MIS \& Reporting 100% on time MIS \& report generation
  
  

**Mandatory Skills:** MuleSoft Development .
  
  

**Experience:** 5\-8 Years .

jobs.title: Digital Success Manager
jobs.description:
About Us:  

**Location\- Hyderabad**

 **Level \- Support Level**

 **Department \- Customer**

 **Working Pattern \- Work from Office**

 **Benefits \-** **Benefits at Ideagen**

 **Salary \- To be discussed at next stage**

  

We are seeking a Digital Success Manager who is responsible for driving customer adoption, engagement, and retention across a digital\-first customer segment. This role operates at scale, using data, automation, and digital touchpoints to deliver proactive success outcomes across a large portfolio of accounts — without relying on high\-touch, one\-to\-one engagement for every interaction.


Responsibilities:
* Own the end\-to\-end digital customer journey for a defined customer segment (typically SMB or low\-ARR accounts), from onboarding through renewal and expansion.
* Design and execute automated lifecycle campaigns (email, in\-app, webinars) that drive product adoption and feature awareness at scale.
* Monitor customer health scores and usage data to identify at\-risk accounts and trigger appropriate digital or human interventions.
* Collaborate with CS, Product, and Marketing teams to develop self\-serve resources including knowledge bases, video tutorials, and help content.
* Manage and continuously optimise digital engagement programs using tools such as Gainsight, Totango, HubSpot, or similar platforms.
* Analyse cohort data and engagement metrics to identify trends, surface insights, and iterate on program performance.
* Triage and escalate accounts appropriately when digital engagement signals indicate the need for human\-led outreach.
* Support onboarding at scale through guided in\-app experiences, automated check\-in sequences, and digital office hours or webinars.
* Partner with Renewals and Sales to flag expansion signals or churn risk within the digital segment.


Skills and Experience:
* 3–5 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related SaaS role.
* Demonstrated experience managing or contributing to a digital/tech\-touch CS program.
* Comfort working with customer health data, CRM platforms, and CS automation tools.
* Strong written communication skills — able to craft compelling, scalable messaging for diverse customer segments.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and translate it into actionable program changes.
* A customer\-first orientation with the ability to drive outcomes without relying solely on direct relationship management.

**About Ideagen**  

Ideagen is the invisible force behind many things we rely on every day \- from keeping airplanes soaring in the sky, to ensuring the food on our tables is safe, to helping doctors and nurses care for the sick. So, when you think of Ideagen, think of it as the silent teammate that's always working behind the scenes to help those people who make our lives safer and better. Everyday millions of people are kept safe using Ideagen software. We have offices all over the world including America, Australia, Malaysia and India with people doing lots of different and exciting jobs.  

We’re building a future\-ready team, and AI is part of how we work smarter. If you're curious, adaptable and open to using AI to improve how you work, you’ll thrive at Ideagen! **What is next?**  

If your application meets the requirements for this role, our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch to guide you through the next steps.
To ensure a flexible and inclusive process, please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments by contacting us at recruitment@ideagen.com. All matters will be treated with strict confidence.  

At Ideagen, we value the importance of work\-life balance and welcome candidates seeking flexible or part\-time working arrangements. If this is something you are interested in, please let us know during the application process.  

Enhance your career and make the world a safer place!

jobs.title: Project Sales Manager - Basement Parking & Safety Products
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced Project Sales \& Execution Manager for our Basement Parking \& Road Safety Products division.

The candidate will be responsible for generating new business from builders, developers, contractors and infrastructure companies, as well as supervising project execution and installations at customer sites.

**Key Responsibilities**

Business Development \& Sales

\* Develop new business with builders, real estate developers, civil contractors, infrastructure companies and consultants.

\* Identify upcoming construction and basement parking projects.

\* Generate enquiries and convert them into orders.

\* Develop relationships with builders, project heads, consultants, architects, PMC companies and contractors.

\* Conduct regular customer and project\-site visits.

\* Prepare quotations and commercial proposals and follow up until order closure.

\* Maintain a strong pipeline of upcoming projects.

\* Achieve monthly and annual sales targets.

\* Develop repeat business from existing customers.

**Project Execution**

\* Supervise supply and installation activities at project sites.

\* Coordinate with customers, site engineers, contractors and installation teams.

\* Ensure installation is carried out according to specifications and agreed timelines.

\* Plan manpower and material requirements for projects.

\* Monitor project progress and ensure timely completion.

\* Resolve site\-level issues and customer complaints.

\* Coordinate with internal teams for material dispatch and installation schedules.

\* Prepare regular project progress reports for management.

\* Ensure proper quality and workmanship at all sites.

**Candidate Requirements**

\* 5\-10 years of experience in construction sales, building materials, infrastructure products, road safety products, parking solutions or related industries.

\* Experience dealing with builders, developers, contractors and project consultants is highly preferred.

\* Candidates with an existing network among builders, contractors and infrastructure companies will have an advantage.

\* Should have experience in both B2B sales and project/site execution.

\* Strong communication, negotiation and follow\-up skills.

\* Should be willing to travel extensively to customer and project sites.

\* Should be capable of independently handling projects from lead generation order conversion execution completion.

\* Civil Engineering/Diploma or relevant technical qualification will be preferred.

\* Valid driving licence preferred

**Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for someone who is commercially aggressive, technically capable and comfortable working at project sites.

The ideal candidate should be able to bring new projects, convert orders and independently supervise their execution.

jobs.description:
**PATTABHI AGRO FOODS PVT. LTD.**

**JOB DESCRIPTION – SALES \& MARKETING (COMMERCIAL DOMESTIC)**

**Position:** Manager / Senior Manager – Sales \& Marketing  
**Department:** Commercial – Domestic Business  
**Location:** Hyderabad Corporate Office  
**Experience:** 8–12 Years  
**Salary:** Best in the Industry / Commensurate with Experience \& Performance  
**Industry:** Agro Foods / Edible Oils / Food \& FMCG  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**1\. JOB PURPOSE**

To drive the company's **domestic sales and marketing operations**, develop new business opportunities, strengthen customer relationships, achieve revenue targets, and expand the market presence of **Pattabhi Agro Foods Pvt. Ltd.** and its products.

The position will be responsible for developing and executing effective sales strategies across domestic markets while coordinating closely with Commercial, Procurement, Production, Logistics, Finance and other relevant departments.

**2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Sales \& Business Development**

* Develop and implement domestic sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly and annual targets.
* Identify new customers, distributors, dealers, institutional buyers and business opportunities.
* Generate new leads and convert them into sustainable business relationships.
* Expand the company's customer base and geographical market presence.
* Develop sales plans based on market demand, pricing and competition.
* Achieve assigned sales volume, revenue and profitability targets.
* Monitor sales performance and take corrective actions wherever required.

**B. Customer \& Channel Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
* Manage distributors, dealers, institutional customers and other domestic business partners.
* Understand customer requirements and ensure timely resolution of commercial issues.
* Conduct regular customer visits and market reviews.
* Develop long\-term business relationships with key customers.

**C. Market Development \& Marketing**

* Conduct market research to identify new business opportunities and emerging trends.
* Monitor competitor activities, pricing, products and market strategies.
* Develop market\-entry strategies for new territories and products.
* Support promotional activities, product positioning and brand\-building initiatives.
* Provide regular market intelligence and competitor analysis to Management.

**D. Commercial \& Pricing**

* Prepare and negotiate commercial proposals, quotations and business terms.
* Coordinate with Management regarding pricing and commercial approvals.
* Monitor customer\-wise profitability and contribution margins.
* Ensure compliance with approved pricing, credit and commercial policies.
* Coordinate with Accounts/Finance for payment follow\-up and outstanding collections.

**E. Sales Planning \& Reporting**

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly sales plans and MIS reports.
* Track actual sales against targets and analyze deviations.
* Submit regular reports on sales, customer development, market conditions and collections.
* Maintain accurate customer and sales data.
* Prepare sales forecasts and business projections for Management review.

**F. Coordination with Internal Departments**

* Coordinate with Production and Procurement teams to ensure product availability.
* Coordinate with Logistics/Dispatch teams for timely delivery to customers.
* Work closely with Finance/Accounts for billing, collections and credit\-related matters.
* Coordinate with HR and Administration for sales\-team requirements.
* Ensure smooth communication between customers and internal departments.

**3\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

* Monthly / Annual Sales Achievement
* Revenue Growth
* New Customer Acquisition
* Territory / Market Expansion
* Customer Retention
* Gross Margin / Contribution
* Collection \& Outstanding Control
* Distributor / Dealer Network Development
* Sales Forecast Accuracy
* Market Share Growth
* Customer Satisfaction

**4\. REQUIRED QUALIFICATION**

**Essential:**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Sales \& Marketing / Business Management will be an added advantage.
* Strong knowledge of domestic sales, marketing and business development.

**5\. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE**

* **8–12 years of relevant experience** in Sales, Marketing, Commercial Sales or Business Development.
* Experience in **Agro Foods, Edible Oils, FMCG, Food Products or related industries** will be preferred.
* Candidates with strong domestic market relationships and proven sales achievements will be given preference.

**6\. REQUIRED SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES**

* Strong sales and negotiation skills.
* Business development and market expansion capability.
* Excellent customer relationship management.
* Strong commercial and analytical understanding.
* Good communication and presentation skills.
* Strong leadership and team\-management abilities.
* Target\-oriented and result\-driven approach.
* Ability to work independently and take business decisions.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint and sales MIS.
* Willingness to travel extensively across domestic markets.

**7\. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES**

* High level of ownership and accountability.
* Strong business acumen.

* Good interpersonal and networking skills.

jobs.title: Relationship Manager
jobs.description:
### **Job Summary:**


We are seeking a highly motivated and results\-oriented Relationship Manager to join our dynamic team. The Relationship Manager will be responsible for building and maintaining strong, long\-lasting customer relationships, understanding their needs, and ensuring they receive exceptional service and solutions. This role is crucial for retaining our existing client base and identifying opportunities for growth within their portfolios.


### **Key Responsibilities:**


* Develop and nurture strong, trusted relationships with a portfolio of assigned clients, acting as their primary point of contact.
* Understand clients' business objectives, financial needs, and challenges to proactively identify and propose suitable products and services.
* Conduct regular client meetings, presentations, and reviews to assess satisfaction, address concerns, and explore new opportunities.
* Collaborate closely with internal teams, including sales, product development, and customer support, to ensure seamless service delivery and client satisfaction.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities within existing client accounts to expand service utilization and revenue generation.
* Prepare and present tailored proposals and solutions that align with client requirements and company offerings.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to provide informed advice and maintain a competitive edge.
* Manage client expectations and resolve any issues or complaints promptly and effectively, escalating when necessary.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date client records and activity logs within the CRM system.
* Achieve individual and team\-based sales and retention targets.
* Provide regular reports on client portfolio performance, sales activities, and forecasts to management.

jobs.title: Community Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role** 




 Scale.jobs helps job seekers across the US, Canada, UK, Germany, and Australia get their applications out the door. Hybrid AI \+ human, Techstars '24, profitable, millions of applications processed. Our own data says word of mouth is our biggest channel, and it has grown for 30 straight months without us doing a single deliberate thing about it. People land an offer and tell three friends. This role makes it deliberate. Turn that loose network into a real community that carries people through a brutal stretch of life, and that becomes our strongest acquisition channel as a side effect.
 



  





**What you'll actually be doing** 



* Picking the platform and building the space from zero \- Discord, WhatsApp, Slack, subreddit, whatever you can defend. Then getting the first 100 real members in and talking.
* Running the rituals that keep a community alive: office hours, AMAs with recruiters, resume teardowns, offer\-celebration threads, weekly job\-market roundups. Showing up consistently when nobody is watching yet.
* Finding and empowering the 20\-odd power users who will do more for the community than you can alone. Moderators, alumni who landed offers, people who just like helping.
* Turning member stories into content \- offer announcements, before/after resume threads, "here's exactly how I got the interview" posts \- and getting them in front of people who need to see them.
* Owning the referral loop end to end: when someone lands a job, they should have an obvious, easy, rewarding way to bring their friends in.
* Being the ear on the ground. You'll hear complaints about the product before support tickets do, and you'll bring them straight to us.
* Reporting on what's working with real numbers: active members, retention, referrals attributed, applications and revenue traced back to community.



  





**We'll vibe if you…** 



* Have built a community before and can show us the receipts. Numbers, screenshots, a link we can open. We care much more about "I grew this from 0 to 8,000 and here's what I did in month two" than about years of experience or where you worked.
* Genuinely believe community is a channel, not a cost centre, and can argue for it with data rather than vibes.
* Write well and quickly, in a voice that sounds like a person and not a brand account.
* Are comfortable being visible. This role involves your face and your name, not an anonymous admin login.
* Have real empathy for job seekers. A lot of our members are anxious, rejected, and running low on hope. If you can't sit with that, this will be the wrong job.
* Are fine with US and UK time\-zone overlap for events a few evenings a week.
* Move without being told what to do next. Nobody here will hand you a content calendar.



**Bonus, not required:** 
 you've been through an international job search yourself, or you've moderated a large forum, subreddit, or Discord.
 



  





**What's in it for you** 



* Full ownership of a function from day one, with a title and scope that grow as the community does.
* A profitable company. No runway anxiety, no "we're raising in six months, hang in there."
* Direct access to both founders. You'll pitch ideas to us in person and get an answer the same day, not three sprints later.
* A real budget for tools, events, community rewards, and creator partnerships.
* A product that measurably changes people's lives, which makes the community work much easier than it would be at most companies.
* Compensation matched to what you've actually built, plus performance upside tied to community\-attributed growth.



  





**Want to Fast\-Track Your Profile?** 




 Send your application to
 **hr@scale.jobs** 
 with the following:
 


1. **One community you built.** 
 A link, a screenshot, anything that proves it existed and grew.
2. **The numbers behind it.** 
 Where it started, where it got to, and what you did in month two that actually moved it.
3. **A short note on your first 90 days here.** 
 What you'd build, and in what order.



*No cover letter needed. We read every one of these.*

Amazon's Verification \& Risk Management Operations (VRMO) mission is to make Amazon the safest and most trusted place worldwide to transact online, either by identifying and reporting bad actors or mitigating risk and adhering to compliance laws and regulations according to market\-specific, regional, or global direction. Amazon runs one of the most dynamic online platforms, encompassing dozens of global products with compliance requirements, including, Amazon Marketplace with over 2 million sellers worldwide selling hundreds of millions of items in eleven countries, Amazon Pay and MTurk.  

  

BAR designs and builds the inspection systems, risk models and operational processes that minimise risk and maximise trust across Amazon's global product surface area, by ensuring every transaction and entity is compliant.  

  

We are looking for a highly analytical and result\-oriented Business Analyst who can analyse business decisions, troubleshoot issues, and communicate the findings effectively across different teams while raising the technical bar of the globally distributed analytics team, providing data wrangling expertise, deep understanding of data fundamentals, working with and synthesising very large datasets.  

  

We utilise multiple externally and internally (AWS and other) developed data platforms, including real\-time and close to real\-time platforms, to help create signal out of the mountains of data.  

  

Using LLMs will be critical requirement for this role as it needs experimentation and agent experience.
  

  

Our ideal analyst is one who enjoys discovering and solving complicated problems, can quickly learn complex systems, likes to work with numbers, and takes pride in organising and communicating his work. You should have the technical experience and knowledge to work comfortably using SQL, QuickSight/Tableau/PowerBI and scripting languages (Python/JavaScript) Additionally experience with designing data schemas that will allow you, and colleagues, which include Business Intelligence Engineers and Data Engineers to make sense of the vast datasets we possess.

* Organisation skills – demonstrated ability to work independently to make complex investigations, has self\-discipline, is diligent and can manage time appropriately.

* Experience with Excel

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Are you passionate about defining how AI assistants and agents securely connect to the systems where organizations keep their knowledge, workflows, and business data?


Microsoft 365 Core is building the Copilot Connectors \- the foundation that enables Microsoft 365 Copilot and agentic experiences to discover, understand, and act across enterprise data and applications. ---------------


We are seeking a talented Front End Engineer II to join the Paragon team and help build the future of case management for Stores. jobs.description:
**Life at UiPath**
 The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category\-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.
   

  

 To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self\-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast\-moving, fast\-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.
   

  

 Could that be you?
   

  

**Your mission**
 You'll own one of the platform layers that powers agentic automation. This is a layer that every other product on the platform \- agents, workflows, and RPA \- depends on to do its job. Your charter is to make it the obvious, trusted choice for developers and customers in the agentic era, and to prove that value with real production adoption.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role that pairs high autonomy with high accountability. You will set the vision, own the roadmap, get into the technical design with engineering, sit in customer conversations directly, and carry your story all the way into the field.
   

  

**The platform you'll shape**
 You'll join the team building the foundational layers of UiPath's agentic platform, the layers every agent, process, and workflow depends on.
   

  

* Data Fabric \- the data and context layer. Gives agents and workflows governed, real\-time access to enterprise data, modeling raw records into business entities and a shared semantic layer automations can reason over. The work ahead: turning data into connected context agents can navigate.
* Human\-in\-the\-Loop \- the human\-judgment layer. Whenever an agent, process, or workflow needs a person to review, approve, or handle an exception, it brings the right human in: designing the review interface, routing the task, and delivering it wherever people work. The work ahead: making it first\-class for the agentic era.


**What You'll Do At UiPath**
* Own the vision and roadmap for your platform layer, making sharp tradeoff decisions on complex, ambiguous problems, and proposing a clear path forward rather than just surfacing the ambiguity.
* Drive go\-to\-market. Partner with marketing and sales on positioning, enablement, and demos; create demand and get your wins in front of the field and customers.
* Be the customer's champion. Engage directly in account conversations, get deep into real scenarios, and turn what you learn into validated use cases and roadmap decisions.
* Own outcomes end to end. Take accountability from problem definition through launch, adoption, and the metrics that prove value (e.g. production adoption, task success rate, agent reliability).
* Get technical. Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with engineering on design decisions, dogfood the product yourself, and stay credible on the underlying technology.
* Make it agent\-ready. Translate the fast\-moving agent landscape (LLMs, coding agents, orchestration frameworks, MCP, evals) into a coherent UiPath point of view and a shipping product.
* Raise the bar for the broader product team through thought leadership, a strong point of view in forums, and mentoring.


**What You'll Bring To The Team**
* 8\+ years of product management on technical / platform / developer products, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
* A builder's instinct. You've shipped infrastructure that other builders rely on, and you'd rather prototype and dogfood than write a spec and wait.
* Technical depth. You go deep on technical design with engineering and are comfortable in the product yourself, not just managing from the roadmap.
* Hands\-on with AI, not conceptual. You have built or integrated AI/ML into live products yourself, and you use LLM\-based tools (copilots, coding agents, prototyping tools) in your own daily work. Building products for \- and with \- agents is a fundamental expectation.
* A genuine customer\-champion mindset. You seek out direct customer conversations and let real scenarios drive what you build.
* GTM drive. You've created demand and driven adoption, not just delivered features \- and you can tell a clear "why" and "what" story to any audience.
* Crisp, decision\-rich communication and the ability to influence across engineering, design, sales, and marketing without authority.
* Bias to ownership and action \- you take ambiguous, high\-stakes problems and drive them to a result with minimal direction.


**Nice To Have**
* Experience with data platforms or human\-in\-the\-loop / workflow systems.
* Built or shipped products in the agentic / AI space.
* Background that combines engineering and product.


 Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.
   

  

 Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office\-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.
   

  

 We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

jobs.title: Product Manager — Developer Platform (GitHub)
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Product Manager to own our GitHub platform and developer discovery experience. Developers choose a silicon platform based on the software, tools, and content around it, so how easily they can find and use our software directly shapes product success. You'll own that experience by making our GitHub presence a place that developers trust and making our software easy to find.
   

  

**Your Role**
 Key responsibilities in your new role :
   

  

* Own the company GitHub organization as a developer discovery surface with curated code examples, well\-maintained SDKs, clean repository hygiene, and a tagging and lifecycle discipline where releases, issues, and tags all signal health.
* Set the quality bar for repositories and documentation, so a developer can go from landing on a repo to a working first\-run example fast.
* Improve the path from discovery to acquisition; how developers find, download, and start using our software across GitHub and adjacent surfaces.
* Instrument the funnel (find → acquire → first successful build), find where it breaks, and drive the fixes.
* Partner across engineering, content, analytics, and product teams to get artifacts published, tagged, and kept alive.
* Talk to developers regularly, test assumptions before building, and iterate.


**Your Profile**
 Qualifications and skills to help you succeed :
   

  

* 5\+ years in product management, with depth in developer tools, developer experience, open\-source program management, package/artifact registries, or platform products.
* Experience building or turning around a developer discovery or acquisition surface, e.g. running a company's GitHub organization, building a developer portal, standing up an SDK or samples program, or fixing a broken download and documentation experience.
* Strong GitHub fluency as a product surface: repository hygiene, Actions, releases, tagging and lifecycle, Discussions.
* Enough technical grounding to judge whether a repository is good. Comfortable with SDKs, code samples, and build systems.
* Fluent with product instrumentation and analytics.
* Autonomous. You find the problems, form the diagnosis, and drive the solution across teams. Comfortable with ambiguity and influencing without authority.
* Background in the embedded or silicon ecosystem (MCU, SDKs, toolchains such as STM32, ESP\-IDF, Nordic, Renesas, or similar).
* Open\-source community building.
* Familiarity with developer\-portal catalog frameworks such as Backstage.
* Experience distributing software under licensing or export\-control constraints.

**To be a successful Engineering Manager, you should have experience with:**

* Hands\-on experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Azure AI, or similar platforms.
* Strong commercial mindset with a focus on customer value and business outcomes.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

**Additional Relevant Skills Given Below Are Highly Valued**
* Business\-first thinker with an AI\-native mindset.
* Curious, hands\-on, and passionate about emerging technologies.
* Able to bridge strategy, technology, and execution.
* Outcome\-focused, pragmatic, and driven by measurable value.

 This role is based in Bangalore.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 The purpose of a Product Owner is to maximize the value of the product by defining a clear product vision (are they setting the vision or would this align to ), managing authoring, refining and prioritizing the Product Backlog balancing trade\-offs across desirability, viability and feasibility – making sure the right thing is being ‘built’, and prioritising work based on business goals. They act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring the product meets user/customer needs and delivers optimal value. Product Owners are responsible for developing a roadmap and driving execution of their product area/sub\-journey, applying continuous improvement principles and techniques.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Ensure Product Alignment with Business Goals: Ensure that the product \& its features are aligned with broader objectives, driving value and contributing to the organization’s overall strategy. Utilisation of market research, analysis of customer feedback and monitoring of industry trends to identify new products, features or enhancements.
* Communicate Product Vision to Delivery Teams: Clearly articulate the product vision and goals to the delivery teams, ensuring they understand, align and are inspired to deliver the business value and purpose of each feature or user story.
* Create and Refine User Stories: Write clear, concise user stories with detailed acceptance criteria, refining them as needed to ensure the development team has all the necessary information to implement features successfully.
* Agile Events: Participate in key Agile events such as sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to keep the team aligned and focused on delivering the product backlog.
* Managing the Product Backlog: Responsible for creating, maintaining, and prioritising the product backlog, ensuring the highest value features are delivered first, based on business needs, customer requirements and organisational impacts, balancing risk migration and future proofing against the product strategy.
* Act as the Voice of the Customer: Continuously gather feedback from customers and end\-users to understand their pain points and ensure that the product meets their needs and improves their overall experience.
* Acceptance Criteria Definition \& Management: Review and accept or reject work completed by the development team during sprints, ensuring that all delivered features meet the agreed\-upon acceptance criteria and deliver business value.
* Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with stakeholders (e.g., customers, business leaders, and marketing teams) to gather requirements, define product goals, and ensure that the product vision aligns with business objectives.
* Monitor Product Performance and Iterate: Regularly assess product performance using KPIs and customer feedback, adjusting the product backlog and roadmap to improve functionality and meet evolving customer needs. Manage on\-going readiness and 'run' activities of live products including monitoring, governance and approvals.
* Risk and Control: Managing risk, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to resolve or mitigate and escalate as necessary those risks, and alignment between the product management and control functions.

jobs.description:
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s supporting our songwriters, ensuring we provide the right royalty data to global partners, or helping our creative teams use the latest AI tools to discover new talent, technology plays an invaluable role in our success. Product Managers help turn vision into reality.
   

  

 We are looking for a Product Manager to partner with a local in\-person engineering team in Bengaluru focused on music distribution. Distribution is the vital link between music creation and a fan’s headphones, ensuring our music reaches platforms like Spotify and YouTube globally while protecting the complex rights that ensure our artists get paid. You will be a "user\-first" thinker who is responsible for a portfolio of features and products, navigating the high\-stakes world of global rights, supply chain automation, and high\-scale digital delivery.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Continuous Discovery: Build deep empathy for our labels, operations teams, and global partners by maintaining a constant dialogue with them. Uncover their underlying pain points, ensuring that every solution we build truly solves their problems and makes their daily workflows more seamless.
* Strategy \& Roadmap: Define and communicate the long\-term vision and roadmap for your products, ensuring they align with WMG’s broader tech strategy.
* Product Trio Collaboration: Work in a "Product Trio" alongside Engineering and Design to solve complex problems, resolving trade\-offs and tackling risks.
* Execution \& Ownership: Serve as the primary author of PRDs and the "executor\-in\-chief" for your projects, driving development from ideation through technical delivery.
* Launch \& Impact: Develop comprehensive go\-to\-market strategies, including product positioning, internal messaging, and launch plans. You don't just "ship" code; you ensure the organization is ready to adopt it to achieve maximum impact.
* Analytical Optimization: Continuously monitor product performance metrics, user feedback, and market trends. Use this data to make informed prioritization decisions, identify areas for improvement, and manage technical debt to optimize the product over its entire lifecycle.


**Who You Are**
* Experienced: You have at least 5 years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to the music business or other digital media.
* Technical \& Business Savvy: You can discuss system architecture with engineers and business constraints with executives, mitigating Value, Usability, Feasibility, and Business Viability risks upfront.
* A Master Storyteller: You own the "Why" and can easily adjust your communication style for different audiences, from developers to more senior stakeholders.
* Biased to Action: You have a proven ability to unstick a team, make difficult prioritization decisions, and navigate the ambiguity of a global business.
* Humble Leader: You have strong opinions, held weakly; you are quick to share credit with your team and accept responsibility when things don’t go as planned.
* Mission\-Driven: You are a music fan motivated by the fact that your work directly impacts an artist’s ability to grow their career and get paid.

If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**About Bluevine**
 Bluevine is the largest small business banking platform in the U.S., redefining how entrepreneurs manage their money. We create modern financial solutions, from checking and lending to payments and beyond, designed to help small business owners grow, thrive, and take control of their financial future. Our best\-in\-class technology, advanced security, and deep understanding of the small business community give our customers the confidence to focus on what they do best.
   

  

 Since 2013, we’ve supported more than 750,000 small businesses nationwide. Backed by leading investors like Lightspeed Venture Partners, Menlo Ventures, 83North, and Citi Ventures, our 500\+ person global team shares one mission: to give small businesses the financial tools they need to succeed.
   

  

 We’re innovators driven by big ideas, collaboration, and real impact. Here, you’ll have the freedom to take ownership, grow your career, and make a difference for small business owners across America. Ready to shape what’s next?
   

  

**ABOUT:**
 Bluevine is looking for an experienced Product Manager who will own and drive the roadmap for payments, collections, capital markets, accounting \& finance for the lending business unit. The platform and systems used in this domain are mission\-critical and impact the experience for our clients and serves as the backbone for internal stakeholders’ workflows.
   

  

 This person will be responsible for articulating the business case for and delivering new features as well as enhancing our existing solutions, based on customer and stakeholder feedback and data driven analyses. This role will require collaboration with a broad set of technical and non\- technical stakeholders, including R\&D, risk and back\-office operations, support, business operations, accounting and finance teams, and legal \& compliance.
   

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**
* Own and drive the product roadmap for payments, collections, capital markets, and accounting \& finance within the lending business unit — aligning features and initiatives to company strategy, OKRs, and KPIs through close collaboration with leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders
* Conduct business discovery and gather requirements from a broad set of internal stakeholders, including risk, back\-office operations, accounting, finance, and legal \& compliance teams
* Define detailed technical specifications for new features and projects, outlining business requirements, acceptance criteria, and system design considerations — serving as a precise guide for engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle
* Partner closely with R\&D and QA teams through sprint planning and execution, conducting UAT before production deployments and driving issues and bugs to resolution
* Monitor and maintain mission\-critical systems across payments, accounting, and capital markets — ensuring data accuracy, integrating with banks and vendors, and enhancing internal operational tools for efficiency and scalability

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Global Expansion
jobs.description:
Who we are
   

  

**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 We’re hiring a Product Manager to lead Stripe’s India business strategy and product roadmap. We are seeking a highly entrepreneurial, data\-driven product leader who will own growth, go\-to\-market, and product execution for India. You will shape how Stripe serves India’s rapidly evolving digital economy \- from domestic merchants and platforms to ambitious Indian companies scaling globally \- and move quickly to capture significant market opportunities.
   

  

 India is one of the fastest\-growing markets in the world: vast consumer demand, rapid merchant digitization, and a vibrant startup ecosystem. At the same time, Indian businesses are increasingly global \- building products and services that sell across borders. This role sits at the intersection of domestic market expansion and global enablement: you’ll build products and commercial plays that unlock revenue across India and empower Indian companies to reach customers worldwide. The impact you drive will influence Stripe’s position in an increasingly strategic market.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the India product strategy and roadmap end\-to\-end: define vision, prioritize initiatives, and measure outcomes tied to growth, revenue, and merchant satisfaction.
* Lead cross\-functional teams (engineering, design, data science, ops, legal/compliance, sales, partnerships) to deliver product features, integrations, and commercial programs tailored to India.
* Move quickly from insight to experiment: design and run rapid experiments, launch localized features and pricing, and iterate based on quantitative and qualitative feedback.
* Deeply understand Indian merchants, platforms, PSPs, gateways, regulators and payment rails; translate market dynamics into product differentiation and commercial opportunity.
* Build products and flows that make it simpler for Indian businesses to sell globally — cross\-border routing, FX and reconciliation, compliance, payout rails, and developer experience improvements.
* Partner with partnerships and business development teams to secure and scale strategic distribution and platform integrations.
* Represent the product and market perspective to regional and global stakeholders; provide clear decision\-making and trade\-off rationale.


 Who you are
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
   

  

**Minimum Requirements**
* Demonstrated product leadership in payments, fintech, marketplaces, or developer platform products, with 12\+ years of experience in product management or equivalent roles.
* Deep knowledge of the Indian payments and commerce ecosystem: local payment methods, banks, regulatory landscape.
* Track record of shipping localized products and scaling go\-to\-market plays in India (or similar complex emerging markets).
* Strong analytical instincts: experience running experiments, using metrics to drive decisions.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and skilled at prioritizing high\-impact initiatives while moving quickly and iterating.
* Excellent communicator and collaborator who can influence across engineering, legal, operations, and sales.
* Customer\-obsessed with first\-hand experience talking to merchants, partners, and developer communities; able to translate feedback into product requirements.
* Entrepreneurial mindset, bias for action, and experience operating with limited resources to unlock outsized outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with cross\-border payments, currency conversion, payouts, or compliance for global trade.
* Prior work with developer platforms, SDKs/APIs, or businesses that serve platforms and marketplaces.
* Experience liaising with regulators or navigating complex compliance requirements.


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
   

  

 Apply now

jobs.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


**Introduction to team:**
-------------------------

Data is central to how Expedia Group operates, serves travellers, and makes decisions. When data is incomplete, inaccurate, delayed, or difficult to interpret, the impact can extend across products, analytics, operations, and customer experiences.


The Data Quality Platform team is responsible for building a centralized, scalable, and extensible platform that helps teams proactively understand, validate, and trust their data across batch and streaming datasets. We provide automated profiling, configurable quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, alerting, and data health visibility so data producers can identify and resolve issues closer to the source.


We focus on building reliable, high\-performance, secure, and cost\-effective platform services that integrate with data pipelines and analytical systems. Typical technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, REST, gRPC, Amazon Web Services, Spark, Kafka, Airflow and Agentic AI. We encourage experimentation with new technologies, including machine\-assisted data quality workflows, while balancing short\- and long\-term goals and maintaining a high bar for platform quality and operational excellence.  



  

**In this role, you will:**
---------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop one software engineering team responsible for designing, building, and operating robust, scalable, and secure Data Quality Platform services.
* Set technical direction for your team across data profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, alerting, incident management, and data health experiences.
* Lead and collaborate on complex, cross\-organizational initiatives, making thoughtful resource, delivery, product, and architectural trade\-offs to maximize strategic value.
* Partner closely with product managers, architects, program managers, data platform teams, and data domain owners to prioritize roadmaps, clarify requirements, and deliver measurable outcomes.
* Define and raise engineering standards for coding, testing, architecture, observability, security, continuous delivery, performance, and cost management.
* Ensure reliable operation of production systems through effective on\-call strategies, incident management, root\-cause analysis, capacity planning, and continuous improvement of service\-level indicators and objectives.
Safely integrate and operate machine\-assisted capabilities that improve rule authoring, anomaly detection, and issue explanation, applying artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts to practical data platform workflows.  
* 

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent Level; Technical Degree Preferred.
* 8\+ years of relevant professional experience and 3\+ years of people management experience.
* Proven track record of end\-to\-end ownership for complex software or data platform systems, including system design, application programming interface design, data modelling, implementation, and ongoing operations within a defined product or domain scope.
* Strong proficiency in core software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, testing, continuous integration and delivery, and building secure, reliable, and observable services.
* Experience working with data platforms, data quality, data observability, data pipelines, data contracts, analytics systems, or a closely related domain.
Demonstrated ability to set technical direction, make data\-driven trade\-offs, and align cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver high\-quality software at scale.  
* 

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Experience leading a software engineering team within a large\-scale, distributed technology environment, with accountability for team\-level architecture, technical strategy, and delivery outcomes.
* Track record of designing and evolving high\-throughput data systems, including service decomposition, data modelling at scale, backward\-compatible application programming interfaces, and integration with batch or streaming pipelines.
* Deep experience with production operations at scale, including site reliability engineering practices, capacity planning, performance optimization, and building systems for high availability and resilience.
* Demonstrated ability to drive architectural modernization, platform migration, or legacy system deprecation while maintaining strong delivery and operational outcomes.
* Experience with cloud\-native data processing, workflow orchestration, data contracts, anomaly detection, machine\-assisted software or data quality workflows, and observability platforms.
* Proven ability to build an inclusive, high\-performance engineering culture and develop engineers through feedback, coaching, career planning, and meaningful technical opportunities.

jobs.title: Data Analyst, Finance and Payments
jobs.description:
**About Handshake**
===================


Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.


In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

**Why join Handshake now:**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue

**About Handshake AI**


Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data\-intensive post\-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3\-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.

  

**About the Role****:**
=======================


We are looking for a Data Analyst to support the Finance and Central Operations organization and help build the data infrastructure, reporting, and analytics that power financial and operational decision\-making.


This role combines analytics, data engineering, and applied data science, with a strong focus on translating complex operational data into reliable financial insights. While reporting within the Finance team, this role will also partner closely with the Payment Operations team, helping improve the data, controls, and automation behind high\-volume payment processes.


This role requires close collaboration with our San Francisco–based team and availability during core U.S. business hours.

  

**Desired Capabilities:**
=========================

* 3–6\+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, data engineering, financial analytics, or a related field.
* Build and maintain scalable Finance and Operations dashboards and reporting across revenue, project expenses, margins, cash flows, payments, and other key financial and operational metrics.
* Develop automated data pipelines across systems that bring together information from financial, operational, and business systems.
* Identify and execute opportunities to automate existing financial reporting processes, reducing manual effort and improving the consistency and reliability of recurring deliverables.
* Contribute to the buildout of finance data infrastructure, automate recurring reporting, and reduce reliance on manual, spreadsheet\-based processes.
* Partner with Payment Operations to build reporting and analytics around payment volumes, accuracy, exceptions, disputes, and processing performance.
* Develop automated reconciliations and controls to identify missing, duplicate, incorrect, or unusual payments.
* Support the investigation and resolution of payment discrepancies through data analysis.
* Help improve and automate payment workflows, including data validation and exception management.
* Partner with Finance and Operations stakeholders to translate business questions into data models, dashboards, and actionable analysis.
* Establish documentation, data definitions, and controls that improve the reliability and auditability of Finance and Payments reporting.
* Experience with Python or another analytical programming language.

  

***Extra Credit******:***
=========================

* Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
* Experience building dashboards and reporting using tools such as Hex, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
* Familiarity with modern data warehouses and transformation tools such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, or similar.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, reconciliation, and automation.
* Ability to understand financial and operational processes and translate them into technical solutions.
* Strong analytical mindset and ability to independently investigate discrepancies and ambiguous data problems.
* Experience working with Finance teams strongly preferred.
* Experience with payment operations, high\-volume contractor payments, or other transaction\-heavy environments is a plus.

  

**Perks****:**
==============

* Generous equity grant, vested over 4 years
* Well\-defined performance bonus ranging between 10–100% of base
* Premium medical insurance coverage
* Food credit for every in\-person day

jobs.description:
**Role Name: Business Analyst \- GTM (Go\-To\-Market)**
=======================================================

### **At Kapture CX, we are looking for a Business Analyst in our GTM team**


.**Who are we?**
---------------


Kapture CX is a leading SaaS platform that helps enterprises automate and elevate customer experience through intelligent, AI\-powered solutions. We partner with enterprises across industries to bring scalable automation and insight\-driven efficiencies to their CX operations.
Over a thousand clients across 18 countries have used Kapture’s products to enhance their customer experience, including Unilever, Reliance, Coca\-Cola, BigBasket, Meesho, Airtel Payments Bank, and Cathay Pacific. Kapture delivers industry\-specific solutions powered by AI, tailored workflows, and seamless automation.
Kapture CX is headquartered in Bangalore, with offices in Mumbai and Delhi/NCR, as well as international offices across the USA, UAE, Singapore, Philippines, and Indonesia.**What is this role all about?**
================================


At Kapture CX, our GTM team drives strategic expansion, revenue execution, and operational efficiency across growth and customer\-facing functions. As a Business Analyst \- GTM, you will work on high\-impact initiatives, taking ownership of projects end\-to\-end while driving program management and business analytics to optimize Go\-To\-Market execution.
Rather than managing routine operational tickets, you will lead end\-to\-end GTM projects, streamline cross\-functional programs, leverage data to deliver actionable insights, and build scalable workflows that help leadership make smarter decisions.**Sounds interesting?**
=======================

### **Here's a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:**

* **End\-to\-End Project \& Program Management:** Own and execute strategic GTM projects from conception to completion, ensuring alignment across cross\-functional teams, clear milestone tracking, and timely delivery.
* **Business Analytics \& Insights:** Conduct deep\-dive business analytics across GTM data, customer journeys, and operational metrics to deliver dashboards, reports, and insights that support leadership decision\-making.
* **Workflow \& Process Optimization:** Analyze GTM and customer\-facing operational workflows to identify bottlenecks, streamline cross\-departmental handoffs, and design scalable, data\-driven solutions.
* **AI \& Automation Integration:** Build and implement AI\-powered tools such as knowledge assistants, chatbots, and workflow copilots to improve team productivity.
* **Cross\-Functional Ownership:** Lead strategic cross\-functional programs (e.g., Customer360, Self\-Service Portals, Enablement) by owning analysis, documentation, and execution workstreams.

**This is a Bangalore\-based role.** We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in\-person collaboration drives innovation and faster execution.**What does success look like in this role?**
=============================================


You seamlessly lead GTM projects end\-to\-end, ensuring cross\-functional initiatives move efficiently through structured program management. Leadership relies heavily on the business analytics, dashboards, and reporting models you build to make informed decisions, while your process improvements and automations noticeably accelerate GTM operations.**What would make you a good fit for this role?**
=================================================

### **Here are the basic requirements:**

* **Experience:** 2–4 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Program Manager, or Project Manager with a solid **SaaS background** (B2B SaaS preferred).
* **Project \& Program Management:** Hands\-on experience managing projects end\-to\-end using tools like JIRA, Notion, Asana, ClickUp, or Monday.com.
* **Business Analytics \& Data Tools:** Highly proficient in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for handling large datasets, reporting, and dashboard creation; experience with BI platforms is a plus.
* **AI \& Automation Native:** Comfortable working with AI tools (e.g., OpenAI, Claude) and understanding how to apply them to optimize business workflows.

**What are the most critical skills for this role?**
====================================================

* End\-to\-end program and project management with structured execution and milestone tracking.
* Strong business analytics capabilities and structured problem\-solving to break down complex datasets into actionable solutions.
* Proactive identification of automation opportunities across GTM workflows.
* Clear executive communication and seamless collaboration across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success.

**You will have an advantage if you:**
======================================

* Have strong experience with SaaS CRM, Customer Success, or revenue platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).
* Have built internal tools, AI assistants, or low\-code/no\-code automation workflows for GTM teams.
* Have previously driven cross\-functional enablement or GTM operations in a scaling SaaS environment.

**Why should you be interested?**
=================================

### **Here's what you will gain from this role:**

* Direct ownership of core Go\-To\-Market programs, analytics, and end\-to\-end execution.
* Mentorship from senior leaders with a clear trajectory toward Program Management and Operations leadership.
* Hands\-on exposure at the intersection of SaaS, Business Analytics, and AI technology.
* Rapid career acceleration within a fast\-growing global SaaS organization with competitive compensation.

**Does this sound like you?**
=============================


Click the Apply button to let us know!

jobs.title: Senior Business Hub Expert – SAP  Quality Management
jobs.description:
**Purpose of the Job:** 



* The incumbent is expected to analyze (regional/segment\-specific) business requirements towards the global template SAP S/4HANA system in local fit\-gap analyses under leadership of deputy/hub process owners. They will actively contribute to the roll\-in of assigned projects in a region.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 5\+ years of relevant professional experience in driving business process transformation within Greenfield and Brownfield SAP implementation projects.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end SAP Quality Management (QM) and Plan\-to\-Produce (P2P) business processes.
* Hands\-on knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, with a strong focus on Production Planning (PP) and Quality Management (QM).
* Experience in business requirements analysis, process design, and business process modelling.
* Proven track record of successfully delivering complex projects in large international organizations, collaborating with cross\-functional and global stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and conceptual thinking, with a results\-oriented approach and keen attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and IT teams.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills; proficiency in German or other languages is an added advantage.



  





**Key Responsibilities \& Accountabilities:** 



* Analyze regional and segment\-specific business requirements against the global SAP S/4HANA template by conducting local fit\-gap analyses under the guidance of Deputy/Hub Process Owners.
* Drive the adaptation and harmonization of end\-to\-end business processes, including process modelling, to align with FIT4 standardization objectives, while coordinating with entity business experts on preparatory activities such as data cleansing.
* Develop and maintain process maps and business process models to document and communicate the adapted business processes.
* Define, plan, and execute cutover activities, with a focus on data migration, role setup, and business readiness to ensure a seamless transition to SAP S/4HANA.
* Design, own, and execute functional end\-to\-end test scenarios and test cases to validate business processes within the SAP S/4HANA solution.
* Support the successful rollout of assigned regional deployment projects, primarily within the designated business segment and, where required, across multiple SBUs or segments in coordination with the Regional Hub Lead.
* Collaborate with the Training Lead to develop training materials and, when required, deliver end\-user training to support business adoption.

jobs.title: Strategy and Analytics Business Partner
jobs.description:
Who we are
   

  

**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies \- from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups \- use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Internal System Org is at the core of Stripe to empower mission\-critical financial domains including Finance \& Strategy (F\&S), Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Product Experience, GTM. We are the Financial Enablement team, acting as the centralized data analytics team for Internal System Org. Enable and empower F\&S, GTM, Accounting, Product teams to achieve business goals, through dataset development, data analytics support, dashboards, AI, and operation efficiency enhancements.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Perform data analysis, identify trends, conduct research, build visualizations, all to deliver objective, critical insights that fulfill team stakeholders’ business needs
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including Finance \& Strategy, Accounting, Product, Tax, User billing, Seller System, and Sales Ops teams, to align on financial goals and drive revenue growth
* Be the data strategy partner for our business stakeholders
* Reconcile complex dataset across complex finance systems
* Coordinate cross\-functional projects to identify and drive operational efficiencies that support our stakeholders ability to run more efficiently and effectively
* Work closely with Engineering and Product teams to help define product solutions
* Leverage AI tools to improve team work efficiency
* Conduct internal knowledge sharing sessions to strengthen team


 Who you are
   

  

 You’re passionate about solving business problems and making a direct impact on business. You thrive in environments with many moving parts and quickly pick up new domain knowledge and technologies (e.g. AI). We’re seeking someone with excellent communication and advanced SQL/analytics abilities. Strong background in Accounting/Finance or prior AI experience is highly preferred, though these can also be developed on the job.
   

  

**Minimum Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in STEM major (i.e. Computer Science, Math, Stat, Engineering, etc.) and 4\+ years of prior working experience in data analysis fields
* Strong analytical ability, proficiency with SQL (minimum of 3 years advanced SQL) and strong understanding of data relationships
* Experience working with extremely large datasets
* Outstanding communication skills
* Expertise working cross\-functionally to drive business and operational goals
* Excellent project management skills and ability to hold others accountable for results
* Ability to connect the big picture to minute details
* Operating as part of a team adhering to established norms and values
* Ability to identify opportunities to improve the data management processes
* Domain knowledge in Finance/Accounting/GTM


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in fast\-paced environments (e.g. high\-growth fintech/tech company, management consulting)
* Experience working with PM, Engineers, GTM, Accounting Team or Finance Team
* Experience working with financial datasets
* Experience working in fast\-paced environments (e.g. high\-growth fintech/tech company, management consulting)
* Experience with visualization tools
* Experience with AI tools (Claude Code, Kai, etc.)
* Domain knowledge in FinTech Products
* Bachelor's or Master degree in Accounting/Finance major
* CPA/CFA certification


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
   

  

 Apply now
